mapper.sql: id, notification_id, user_id, scope, seq, sender_id, type, title, content, ref_type, ref_id, broadcast_msg_id, dedup_key, create_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notification (notification_id, user_id, scope, seq, sender_id, type, title, content, ref_type, ref_id, broadcast_msg_id, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{notificationId}, #{userId}, #{scope}, #{seq}, #{senderId}, #{type}, #{title}, #{content}, #{refType}, #{refId}, #{broadcastMsgId}, NOW(), NOW())

INSERT IGNORE INTO notification (notification_id, user_id, scope, seq, sender_id, type, title, content, ref_type, ref_id, dedup_key, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{notificationId}, #{userId}, #{scope}, #{seq}, #{senderId}, #{type}, #{title}, #{content}, #{refType}, #{refId}, #{dedupKey}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM notification WHERE broadcast_msg_id = #{msgId} LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM notification WHERE dedup_key = #{dedupKey} LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM notification WHERE notification_id = #{notificationId} LIMIT 1
